title: Denoising data using convex relaxations
abstract: arXiv:2605.02327v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the problem of denoising observations \(Y_i=X_i+Z_i\), where the latent variables \(X_i\) are sampled from a low-dimensional manifold in \(\mathbb{R}^n\) and the noise variables \(Z_i\) are isotropic Gaussian. We propose a convex-relaxation estimator that first reduces dimension by principal component analysis and then projects the observations onto the convex hull of the projected latent manifold. We construct a statistical oracle that estimates its supporting hyperplanes from empirical Gaussian tail probabilities of the noisy sample. Under a lower-mass condition on the latent distribution, we prove finite-sample guarantees for the oracle and derive error bounds for the resulting denoiser. The analysis combines risk bounds for least-squares projection under convex constraints (due to Chatterjee) with entropy bounds for the manifold. translated_title: 利用凸松弛进行数据去噪
translated_abstract: 我们研究对观测值 \(Y_i=X_i+Z_i\) 进行去噪的问题，其中潜在变量 \(X_i\) 采样自 \(\mathbb{R}^n\) 中的一个低维流形，噪声变量 \(Z_i\) 为各向同性高斯噪声。我们提出了一种凸松弛估计器，它首先通过主成分分析降低维度，然后将观测值投影到投影后潜在流形的凸包上。我们构造了一个统计预言机，利用噪声样本的经验高斯尾部概率来估计其支撑超平面。在潜在分布满足下界质量条件下，我们为该预言机证明了有限样本保证，并推导出所得去噪器的误差界。该分析结合了凸约束下最小二乘投影的风险界（由 Chatterjee 提出）与流形的熵界。我们还针对低温电子显微镜观测模型验证了该框架的假设……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于凸松弛的去噪估计器，先通过主成分分析降维，再将观测投影到潜在流形的凸包上，并在有限样本下证明了去噪误差保证，可应用于低温电子显微镜等场景。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a convex-relaxation denoising estimator that first reduces dimensionality via PCA and then projects observations onto the convex hull of the latent manifold, proving finite-sample error guarantees with applications such as Cryo-Electron Microscopy.
